notes.title: Yago no more on Steam
notes.content:
I would like to inform you that this game will soon be deleted from the servers of Steam, the reason is that the objectives have not been fulfilled and I preferred to take this measure.
So if you're thinking about buying the game, don't buy it!

Thank you.

notes.title: Yago, the Coquerrestrial now in Steam
notes.content:
Now you can buy the adventure Point'n Click Yago, the Coquerrestrial for only 11,99.

Yago, the Coquerrestrial is a "Point & Click" third person adventure in which you play the character of a little alien from planet Coque..

You will interact with the diferent characters, items and elements that conforms the different stages using an easy "Get/Use" radial menu in order to talk, taste, look and interact with the environment.

You'll find puzzles that will increase their difficult in the same way you advance in the adventure, consistent in four stages.

- Comedy adventure totally original.

- Free exploration without fear to dead ends or die.

- Yago'll answer you ironically and impertinent most of times if one action doesn't work.

- Original system to increase or reduce the character speed (x2).

- All puzzles has been designed to be consistent inside the game, removing the fourth wall.
